CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: stdlib/redgarden/bloodflower_mod.prn: REDGARDEN's first real PARENA mod (on-moon-zenith), compiled via 'parena build' and linked directly into REDGARDEN's C binaries -- pure C-to-C, no cgo layer needed. Verified live: REDGARDEN's new tests/test_bloodflower.c exercises the real compiled mod end-to-end. (sess-20260825-0828-cc32a704)
